definitions.gloss: face down; upside down; with the back side showing
definitions.explanation: The state of something being turned so that the back, underside, or hidden side faces up or outward.

examples.japanese: ⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{裏向|うらむ}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧。
⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{裏向|うらむ}きになっている⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{裏向|うらむ}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飾|かざ}られていた→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧{気|き}づかなかった。
examples.english: The photo was displayed face down, so nobody noticed.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧ (back, reverse side) + ⟦{向|む}き→向き：12041_muki⟧ (facing, direction). Describes the orientation of an object where the back or hidden side is exposed. The opposite is ⟦{表向|おもてむ}き→表向き：17918_omotemuki⟧ (face up, outward-facing), though ⟦{表向|おもてむ}き→表向き：17918_omotemuki⟧ also has the figurative meaning of 'ostensible' or 'on the surface.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {裏向|うらむ}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: to place face down
- {裏向|うらむ}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to turn face down
- {裏向|うらむ}きになっている: to be inside out / face down

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{表向|おもてむ}き→表向き：17918_omotemuki⟧: face up, outward-facing — the opposite orientation; also means 'ostensibly'
- ⟦{裏返|うらがえ}し→裏返し：14032_uragaeshi⟧: turned inside out — emphasis on the action of flipping over
- ⟦{上向|うわむ}き→上向き：27459_uwamuki⟧: facing up — oriented upward
- {下向|したむ}き: facing down — oriented downward
